lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Guided practice B: argument and presentation

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Read once, then cover the example and try the guided set from memory.

items.prompt: A data set is 10, 15, 20, 25, 30. The mean is 20. What is the mean absolute deviation?

steps: Identify what the problem is asking and which quantities, assumptions, or constraints matter.
Build and solve a model, then check the result against the context.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A student claims a box that is 3 by 4 by 6 units has a volume of 13 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 14 cubic units, not 13.
Yes; the volume is 13 cubic units.
No; the volume is 15 cubic units, not 13.
No; the volume is 72 cubic units, not 13.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $12 base fee plus $7 per hour. A customer's total bill was $61. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 3 m, then descends another 10 m, then ascends 18 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 33 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $1000 rate will increase by 20%. What does the model predict as the new rate?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 3 ft long, 3 ft wide, and 5 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 27, 32, 37, 42, 47. The mean is 37. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 4 by 3 by 2 units has a volume of 28 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 24 cubic units, not 28.
No; the volume is 29 cubic units, not 28.
Yes; the volume is 28 cubic units.
No; the volume is 30 cubic units, not 28.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $18 base fee plus $3 per hour. A customer's total bill was $51. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 25 m, then descends another 22 m, then ascends 8 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 53 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $80 rate will decrease by 10%. What does the model predict as the new rate?
